vetSays.line: 🛡️ the person in their 30s, with calloused knuckles, the person in their 50s, Elie, Didier and Elena met them at the door — 5 put down. the person in their 30s, with calloused knuckles, the person in their 50s, Elena are hurt.
🛡️ Hugo, Skylar, Chen, Elie and Didier met them at the door — 5 put down. Hugo, Skylar, Chen, Elie, Didier are hurt.
🛡️ Hugo, Skylar, Elie, Somchai and Katarina met them at the door — 5 put down. Hugo, Skylar, Somchai, Katarina are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Elie just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Somchai just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Owen just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Somchai just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Hugo, Skylar, Chen, Elie and Somchai met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 barely walked away. Hugo, Skylar, Chen, Elie, Somchai are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Hugo just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
It saw the opening coming — braced, scar tissue white. Your first strike glances off. (SCARRED: -3 first strike)
Hugo strikes the Scarred The Big Beast.
The Scarred The Big Beast falls.
📺 Hugo brought down Scarred The Big Beast. Together. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
📣 Hugo brought down Scarred The Big Beast. Together.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Owen just put down Big Loud... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. An Elder veteran.
The Elder Ugly-Eyes falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Elder Ugly-Eyes!
★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: European Elder — named and noted.
Elie showed Owen the European Elder — "remember it." The haven hears about it by supper.
Elie showed Rosa the European Elder — "remember it." Word travels before the lesson cools.
Katarina showed Didier the European Elder — "remember it." Word gets around.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Matvei just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
